schema_note: The second shape: a STANDING council. Same vocabulary and conventions as quick-council.json (DECLARED / DERIVED, declare_param, add_motion reached through move, compiled patches). Only fields that differ from quick-council.json carry comments. One format expresses both shapes; it does not follow that a special council GROWS into a standing one by editing — a standing council is constituted by the parent's 50:8-grade act (feedback §11).
kind_cite: 50:7 — constituted to perform a continuing function; 50:8 — standing authority to act, or automatic referral of a class of business, requires constitution by bylaw or by a resolution that is a special rule of order in the PARENT; for a steward-parent that is the steward's act
class_of_business: decisions in the ASF in-place refactor where the right answer depends on which part of the system the decider knows best (specimens-2026-11-03.md)
class_of_business_note: once this council exists, no special council may be seated for a task within this class [50:10]; a special charter declares not_within_standing_class_of against it

standing_authority.may_originate_cite: 50:8 first bullet — only by the parent's special-rule-grade act, which this charter is; original main motions must fall within class_of_business (germane to the class, adjudged when challenged)
standing_authority.may_act_cite: 50:4-5 — 'with power' must be given expressly; absent it the council only reports

authority.parent_powers: as quick-council.json, plus: refer new matters at any time [50:19]; instruct that the 49:21 informalities not apply [50:26]
authority.DERIVED_on_report: deciders: council seats under delegated authority (grant); decided-by: delegated

roll.desc: DECLARED. Identities declared separately (feedback §12): COUNTING identity is the seat; ACCOUNTABILITY identity is the fork key that acted (a re-forked occupant 'did not vote at all' on earlier votes and is eligible to move reconsider under 37:35(2)); CONTINUITY of judgment across sittings is NOT asserted — see logical_time.quarterly-interval. Perspectives name what a seat looks at.

term.ends: DECLARED: on the parent's act, or at a named event (e.g. the refactor's close)
term.seat_turnover: a seat re-assigned to a different SOURCE is a term boundary for that seat (clock.term_boundary_before_next_session = true for the next session)

seats.perspective: what main actually holds, re-derived rather than remembered
what the event trail can and cannot say
who checks whom; continuity against independence in the loop
what the next cold reader finds first
what the change costs to integrate and what it can break

officers.chair_cite: 13:18 — a committee named by a power that did not designate a chair elects its own; the first-named seat calls it together and presides pro tem. With a member-chair the sua-sponte duties return [39, 43, 50:25 n7], its rulings are its own and appealable [24], and it votes as a member on every question [49:21(7)] — compiled below, because the generic vote expression's 'only when it affects the result' cannot be evaluated under sealed voting (feedback §3.1).

quorum.cite: 40:5 default: a majority of the committee (3 of 5)

referred_note: empty at seating; referrals arrive as parent events (a 13:6 main-motion referral, a subject referral with a blank [12:95(a)], or from a parent council a subsidiary commit carrying pending amendments [13:19])

agenda.desc: A standing council has an ORDER OF BUSINESS, a rule [scheduler.json standard_order_of_business; 3:16, 41:5-6], and may adopt an agenda per session [41:61] which then binds and changes only by two-thirds, majority of the entire membership, or unanimous consent [41:63]. Items the PARENT referred are instructions: the council cannot drop them; it may report 'unable to arrive at a recommendation' [51:37] or ask instructions [52:15].
agenda.referred_items_enter_as: general orders in the order referred [41:23, 41:52], or special orders if the parent's referral sets a reporting round/event [14:14, 41:41-42]

list.value: a report on every referred matter, and a periodic report of activity at the end of each term

as quick-council.json (reasons given in debate, votes on the record with pointers to them; minority views of right); each report also names what the council left open and under what evidence it would reopen
as quick-council.json: the final vote on any referred matter is out of order until every seat has been present for at least one closed debate round on it

list.cite: 50:15 — non-member subcommittees only where the committee is appointed to act, which this one is not

list.reply_rule: as quick-council.json: one reply round after exhaustion

value.bounds: within the grant; never touching the parent's instructions

list.value: the call of the next sitting, sent to every seat; notice given at a sitting is recorded in the minutes [10:50]
the chair, or any two seats, or the parent's referral

never from the parent [49:19]; the sycophancy cost of per-seat votes read by the steward is accepted, as in quick-council.json. [guess] a sitting's debate may by majority be marked closed to OTHER agents' future reading; action taken is always open [9:26]

ops.cite: 8:4 — each sitting a session unless an adjourned sitting is set
49:21(7) — the member-chair 'votes on all questions'; the generic affect-the-result condition is unevaluable under sealed voting (feedback §3.1)

excluded_with_reason.motion/limit-extend-debate: disabled by the committee configuration [50:25]; the debate-budget instruction is the parent's order
excluded_with_reason.motion/motions-relating-to-voting: method fixed by the electronic-meeting rules (signed ballot, 45:46)
excluded_with_reason.motion/reconsider-enter-minutes: its object (absentee protection across a day boundary) is served by previous notice across sittings; every seat is asked every round within a sitting

motion.name: Report a Referred Matter
params: q (a referred question finally disposed of in this council)

applies_to.desc: in a STANDING committee 'rise' is never used [50:23]; this emits the report on one disposed matter and does not dissolve the council

motion.effect: emit the report on q per report-form to the parent; the council continues

electronic_meeting_rules.cite: 9:35-36; the 9:34 departure is declared as in quick-council.json
electronic_meeting_rules.informed_acts: as quick-council.json (contention spike I1): one floor-needing act per round; a window-opening transition is followed by a round
electronic_meeting_rules.equipment: as quick-council.json: no member holds read/write access to the council store during a sitting
electronic_meeting_rules.presence_and_quorum: roll round at each call to order; maintained by submission
electronic_meeting_rules.recognition: ladders per protocol.json; residual: earliest claim round, then rotation pointer; the elected chair's assignment among non-preferred claims follows the same declared rule and is appealable as a point of order [42:14-15]
electronic_meeting_rules.motions_in_writing: written; revealed one round before stated
electronic_meeting_rules.voting: signed ballot [45:46] classified as roll-call; the member-chair votes with the members [49:21(7)]; no change round after the reveal

malfunction.effect: absent for the round; decides presence, which feeds quorum and thresholds; latency invariance holds inside the backstop

electronic_meeting_rules.between_sittings: the interstitial action space: receive a referral; call a sitting [50:21]; give previous notice; nothing else

logical_time.end-of-session: adjournment of a sitting that did not set an adjourned sitting [8:4, 8:9]
logical_time.next-regular-session: the next sitting called under calling-a-sitting
logical_time.quarterly-interval: DECLARED, on 8:11-12's principle (the freedom of each new session — a question temporarily disposed of must not bind a later sitting whose grounds have moved; feedback §9): within-quarterly(s1,s2) ≡ no seat crossed a term boundary between s1 and s2 AND no advisory input or referred paper the question rests on has changed (a vsect-style lapse on the record the question depends on; [guess] at the second conjunct's exact form)
logical_time.current_session: the sitting id when no adjourned sitting was set; else the id of the first sitting of the series
logical_time.last_business_day_of_session: true in a sitting the chair has declared the last of its session
logical_time.adjourned_meeting_set: true when fix-time-to-which-to-adjourn named a round or event
logical_time.hour: a (sitting, round), or an event anchor

rule_stack: as quick-council.json, with special-rules-of-order adoptable by the council within the grant [50:26 as instructed above]

dissolution.DERIVED_from_kind: standing: the parent's act, or the term's named end [50:7]; matters referred and not finally reported pass to the successor seats [50:29]

record: as quick-council.json; one log per council; sittings and sessions as records (gaps.json meeting-session-objects)
